question: In a certain code language, 'DOMINATE' is coded as 'TANIMODE' and 'FAITHFUL' is coded as 'UFHTIAFL'. What is the code for 'HIGHWAY' in the given code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : All letters are written diagonally except last letter. So, • 'DOMINATE' is coded as 'TANIMODE'
